name: TweetBench
description: TweetBench is a dataset of Twitter (tweet) texts intended for evaluating or fine-tuning language models on social-media language. It is used for tasks such as language modeling and text generation on short, conversational, noisy social text. The dataset is useful for studying model behavior on informal, real-world microtext and social-media phenomena.
evaluation_method: perplexity for language modeling; accuracy/F1 for classification tasks; BLEU/ROUGE or human evaluation for generation quality
general_score_metric: perplexity (for LM) / accuracy or F1 (for classification)
reputation: A practical, task-oriented tweets corpus available on Hugging Face with moderate use for social-media LM research and fine-tuning.
